title: Library

deleteLibrary.confirmDesc: This permanently deletes the library "{{name}}" and all {{count}} media file records in it (the actual files on disk are not affected). This action cannot be undone.
deleteLibrary.confirmDescEmpty: This permanently deletes the library "{{name}}". This action cannot be undone.

scan.emptyWarning: Please select at least one scan option.

add.label: Scan for new files
add.desc: Discover and register new media files, then scrape pending ones

remove.label: Remove dead entries
remove.desc: Delete database records whose files no longer exist on disk

scrapeOverride.title: Scrape with number
scrapeOverride.contentTypeHint: Leave empty to infer from the number you enter.

batch.confirmDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected media files? This action cannot be undone.
batch.confirmDeleteDesc_one: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected media file? This action cannot be undone.
batch.confirmDeleteDesc_other: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected media files? This action cannot be undone.

detail.title: Media Detail
detail.confirmDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this media file? This action cannot be undone.

noSelectionHint: Choose a library from the sidebar to view and manage its media files, or add a new one.

automation.label: Automation
automation.hint: Watching and auto-scrape; organize stays manual

fieldTrailerPatternHint: Skip files whose names (with extension) match; empty disables. Default matches trailer
fieldBlacklistPatternsHint: One regex per line; matching files are skipped during scan and moved to .amane_trash on organize
fieldMinFileSizeHint: Videos smaller than this are skipped during scan and moved to .amane_trash on organize. Videos only
fieldMoveModeHint: How files are placed onto template paths during organize
fieldWriteNfoHint: Write Emby/Jellyfin compatible NFO during organize
fieldCopyResourcesHint: Sidecar types copied onto library paths; organize tasks may override
fieldVideoTemplateHint: Relative to library root or absolute; see placeholder badges below
fieldLinkTemplateHint: Organize creates a strm or symlink at this path; must be an absolute path outside the library root. Leave empty to skip
fieldLinkModeHint: strm: write a .strm file; symlink: a filesystem symlink to the mounted video
fieldStrmContentTemplateHint: Applies to strm only. Leave empty to write the video absolute path. For cloud playback use /{video_relpath}
advancedTemplatesHint: Leave empty to use backend defaults (usually under {link_dir}). Absolute paths must stay under the library root or safe_dirs.

placeholders.label: Placeholders
placeholders.hint: Click a badge to copy. Names ending in ? are empty when undetected; wrap them in [..] or [[..]] (a group is kept if any placeholder inside has a value). {name|old=new} rewrites output; unlisted keys stay canonical

items.title: Title
items.ext: File extension (no dot). Subtitle template uses that subtitle's extension
items.raw_name: Source video filename. e.g. A/B.mp4 → B
items.raw_dir: Source parent directory name. e.g. A/B/C.mp4 → B
items.video_dir: Directory of the rendered video. Link and sidecar templates
items.video_name: Rendered video filename (no extension). Link and sidecar templates
items.link_dir: Directory of the link; same as {video_dir} when the link template is unset
items.link_name: Rendered link filename (no extension); same as {video_name} when the link template is unset
items.raw_srt_name: Source subtitle filename. e.g. A/foo.zh.srt → foo.zh
